dataset: Licensed care facilities, hospitals and public schools (observed, state licensing and directory data)
snapshot_note: current registry snapshot, not the 2018 roster: closures and openings since 2018 are not reflected

cdph.publisher: California Department of Public Health, Center for Health Care Quality (ELMS)
cdph.licence: data.chhs.ca.gov dataset field data_license = 'Terms of Use' (no SPDX/Creative Commons licence; the portal's terms permit public use with attribution to CDPH)

cdss.publisher: California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing Division
cdss.licence: data.chhs.ca.gov dataset field data_license = 'Terms of Use' (no SPDX/Creative Commons licence; the portal's terms permit public use with attribution to CDSS)

cde.publisher: California Department of Education, California School Directory
cde.licence: no licence stated: the data.ca.gov dataset and the ArcGIS item (accessInformation 'California Department of Education (CDE), United States Census Bureau') carry no licence or terms text. Public data of a state agency; CDE says directory fields are self-reported by LEAs. Treated as a public record; confirm with CDE before redistributing beyond this repository
cde.licence_checked: data.ca.gov package_show and ArcGIS item JSON, 2026-10-24 (licence fields empty)

coordinate_precision: CDSS rows 3 decimals (about 100 m); CDPH and CDE rows 5 decimals (public institutions)
de_identification: CDSS rows carry no name, street address, phone or licensee (small homes are private residences); CDPH contact names, e-mail and phone are dropped; CDE administrator names dropped
capacity_note: capacity is the published licensed capacity (beds or clients); for schools it is enrolment (a proxy, not building capacity); 0 in CDPH means not a bed-based licence
